dashboardDescription: Review student questions where qualified teacher guidance can help.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Set availability and subjects so support requests can be routed clearly.

editor.invalidTime: Enter a valid start and end time.
editor.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
editor.saveFailed: Your availability couldn’t be saved. Please try again.

detail.title: Help Request
detail.description: Review the student's context and record the teacher follow-up.

outOfReach.title: This request is no longer open to you
outOfReach.body: It expired, or another teacher has taken it.

detail.changedElsewhere: Another teacher has taken this request, or it has changed. It has been reloaded — please check where it stands now.
detail.replyDescription: Record the intervention, next step, or follow-up the student needs.
detail.reportContext: Send this request context to the internal moderation queue.
detail.replyPaused: This request could not be refreshed just now. Your draft is kept; you can send it once the connection is back.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.failed: The image could not be loaded.

accept.title: Accept this request
accept.body: Accept the request before you reply. The student then sees that a teacher is on it.
accept.replyRefused: Your reply was not sent: you have not accepted this request yet. Accept it first; your draft is kept.
accept.bodyClassroom: Accept the request. Then you can enter the classroom, where the student joins you.

ended.withdrawn: The student withdrew this request. There is nothing left to do.
ended.expired: This request expired before anyone accepted it. There is nothing left to do.

detail.resolveHint: Done helping? Mark the request resolved. You can still add a reply afterwards.

classroomHelp.title: Online classroom
classroomHelp.body: The student chose the online classroom. Help them there with the whiteboard and voice call. When you are done, mark the request resolved.

profile.title: Teacher Profile
profile.description: Your account details and the teaching coverage students are matched against.
profile.statusDescription: Operational state and latest profile update.
profile.coverageDescription: What students are routed to you for, and when.
profile.noSubjects: No subjects set yet, so no students can be routed to you.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.description: A help request assigned to you always appears in your notifications.

dispatchEmail.title: Email for new help requests
dispatchEmail.body: An email each time a help request is assigned to you, with the subject and a link. It never contains what the student wrote.

notifications.unavailable: Notification settings could not be loaded.
notifications.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.

requests.empty: No teacher support requests are available.
requests.firstActionNone: First teacher action: not recorded yet
requests.statsLoadFailed: The figures could not be loaded.

reply.label: Teacher reply
reply.placeholder: Write the next step for the student.

unsafe.html: Unsafe raw HTML is not allowed.
unsafe.privateMarkers: Private markers cannot be sent in a teacher reply.
unsafe.blockTooLong: This block is too long: {{length}} of at most {{max}} characters. Please shorten or split it.
unsafe.tooManyBlocks: A reply has at most {{max}} blocks. Please merge blocks or remove one.
unsafe.tooLong: The reply is too long: {{length}} of at most {{max}} characters in total. Please shorten it.

attachments.label: Attached pictures
attachments.needsText: Add a few words: a picture on its own cannot be sent yet.

errors.tooMany: A reply carries up to {{count}} pictures.
errors.tooLarge: This picture is too big. Photos may be up to {{imageLimit}}.
errors.unsupported: Only photos can be sent: JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
errors.empty: This file is empty. Please choose another one.
errors.expired: This picture took too long. Please choose it again.
errors.quota: There is no room for pictures right now.
errors.unavailable: Pictures cannot be added right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unreadable: This photo could not be opened. Please try another one, or a screenshot.
errors.blocked: This picture cannot be sent. Please choose a different one, or describe it in words.
errors.failed: This picture could not be added. Please try again.

practiceContext.title: The student requested support after practising this step.
practiceContext.question: Question
practiceContext.help: Learning context helps you see where the student got stuck before joining the request.

moderationReport.title: Report content
moderationReport.submitted: Report sent. The administration will review it (case {{caseId}}).

automationConsole.title: Automation review console
automationConsole.description: Preview and approve batches of practice assignments from reviewed sources. Backend errors are shown as they are, never replaced by sample data.
automationConsole.studentIdPlaceholder: Enter a student id to load their assignments
automationConsole.needStudentId: Enter a student id before previewing automation.
automationConsole.invalidStudentId: This student id is not valid. Check it and try again.
automationConsole.selectedBefore: Run a preview to see the selected candidates.
automationConsole.selectedEmpty: No candidate passed the policy. Check the refusal reasons before changing thresholds.
automationConsole.executeDoneHint: This batch has run. For a new batch, choose “{{action}}” again.
automationConsole.refusedBefore: Policy refusals appear after a preview.
automationConsole.historyNeedStudent: Enter a student id above to see what has been assigned to them.
automationConsole.historyNotLoaded: Leave the field or choose “{{action}}” to load the assignments for this id.
automationConsole.historyFailed: Assignment history could not be loaded
automationConsole.historyNotFound: No student with this id, or not one you can see.
automationConsole.historyEmpty: No assignments for this student yet.

toasts.replyFailed: Your reply could not be sent. Please try again.
toasts.replyConflict: Your reply was not sent: another teacher has taken this request, or it has changed.
toasts.replyNotAccepted: Your reply was not sent: accept the request first.
toasts.replyRefused: Your reply was not accepted. Please check its content and format and send it again.

replyRefusedBecause.html: Your reply was not accepted: part of it looks like HTML code to the server. Please rephrase that part.
replyRefusedBecause.privateMarkers: Your reply was not accepted: it contains internal identifiers or credentials. Please remove them.
replyRefusedBecause.tooManyBlocks: Your reply was not accepted: it has too many blocks. Please merge some.
replyRefusedBecause.blockTooLong: Your reply was not accepted: one of its blocks is too long. Please shorten or split that block.
replyRefusedBecause.tooLong: Your reply was not accepted: it is too long in total. Please shorten or split it.

toasts.replyImagesExpired: The reply was not sent: a picture was no longer valid. Please choose it again, then send once more.
